sources.title: Thanksgiving Dinner Cost Ticks Upward in 2026
Farm Bureau survey shows Thanksgiving cost higher in 2026

lines.say: A classic Thanksgiving dinner for ten costs fifty eight dollars and sixty three cents this year.
lines.show: A classic Thanksgiving dinner for ten costs $58.63 this year.

lines.say: That's about five eighty six a person.
That's up six percent from last year, but still more than eight percent below the twenty twenty two record.
lines.show: That's up 6% from last year, but still more than 8% below the 2022 record.

lines.say: The biggest cost is the turkey. A sixteen pound bird runs twenty three sixty eight, up ten percent.
lines.show: The biggest cost is the turkey. A 16-pound bird runs $23.68, up 10%.

lines.say: But the veggie tray fell three point seven percent, and pie crusts dropped nine cents.
lines.show: But the veggie tray fell 3.7%, and pie crusts dropped 9 cents.

scenes.heading: Cost by region
scenes.source: Dinner for 10. American Farm Bureau Federation, 2026 survey

lines.say: Where you live matters. It's sixty one fifty seven in the Northeast.
lines.show: Where you live matters. It's $61.57 in the Northeast.

lines.say: And fifty four thirty three in the South, the cheapest region.
lines.show: And $54.33 in the South, the cheapest region.

scenes.label: of each food dollar
scenes.note: USDA Food Dollar Series, via AFBF

lines.say: And farmers get less than six cents of every food dollar.
lines.show: And farmers get less than 6 cents of every food dollar.

lines.say: Hosting? Split the dishes with friends and compare stores.
lines.show: Hosting? Split the dishes with friends and compare stores.

lines.say: Some shoppers found turkey for sixty nine cents a pound.
lines.show: Some shoppers found turkey for 69 cents a pound.

scenes.takeaway: Dinner for 10: $58.63. Split ten ways, about $5.86 each.
scenes.source: Data: American Farm Bureau Federation, Nov. 18, 2026
